activity_statements.statement: operates the world's dominant web search engine and serves trillions of search queries annually, monetized through text and display advertising
sells digital advertising inventory across Search, YouTube, and Google Display Network to advertisers reaching global audiences
develops and operates Gemini large language models and AI products including Gemini Live, Gemini Notebook, and Google Labs AI experiments for consumers and developers
provides Google Cloud Platform (GCP) cloud infrastructure, databases, and AI services to enterprise customers, competing with AWS and Azure
distributes Android operating system to smartphone OEMs worldwide and operates Google Play app marketplace charging 15-30% commission on app transactions
designs and sells Google Pixel smartphones, Pixel Watch, and Pixel Buds hardware directly to consumers
operates YouTube as a video streaming platform monetized through advertising and YouTube Premium subscriptions, plus YouTube TV (MVPD service)
operates Google Workspace (Gmail, Docs, Drive, Meet, Calendar) as a SaaS productivity suite sold to businesses and government organizations
operates Waymo autonomous vehicle subsidiary providing robotaxi ride-hailing service in select US cities

segments.name: Google Services (Search, YouTube, Android, Workspace, Maps, Play)

name_reality_gap: Labeled as 'Software Development' but the dominant activity is operating an advertising marketplace — ~77% of revenue derives from selling attention (search ads, YouTube ads, display ads). Google is primarily an advertising business that uses software to aggregate audience.
extraction_notes: Careers teams page returned a JS shell with no content. Investor page had minimal text. Product page was the primary useful source. Segment weighting based on widely reported Alphabet revenue breakdown.
